text:
nina: Hey team — PacificCorp POC kicks off Mon. They require SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and RBAC mapping. They asked for: domain ownership verification approach, SCIM attribute coverage (employeeType, manager, groups), whether SCIM provisioning counts against hosted API usage, and a rough price for ~500 POC users. Any blockers?

evansol: @nina thanks — quick clarifying Qs: do they need Just-In-Time (JIT) user creation via SAML or full SCIM provisioning? They mentioned both but prefer SCIM for deprovisioning.

nina: They prefer SCIM for lifecycle (hire/fire) but want SAML first to get login working for a pilot group.

kevin: From runtime perspective SCIM is supported (v2) with PATCH and PUT. We expose a SCIM endpoint per-tenant in Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we issue a scoped SCIM token. SCIM traffic is throttled separately.

kevin: Example SCIM PATCH we recommend sending for group membership updates:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "add", "path": "groups", "value": [{"value":"team-123","display":"Engineering"}]}
  ]
}
```

priya: A few security notes: 1) Domain verification — we support DNS TXT or SAML metadata verification. DNS TXT is fastest for domain-claim workflows. 2) For Hosted customers who want strict domain enforcement we require both verified domain + SAML assertion check (email domain claim). 3) SCIM tokens are long-lived — we rotate on request and log all SCIM activity for audit.

priya: Also confirm they need RBAC attribute mapping. We support role->group mapping from SCIM groups or SAML attributes (e.g., eduPersonAffiliation / custom role claim).

audrey: On pricing: for POC we typically offer complimentary provisioning for up to 25 active seats. For a 500-user POC we can provide a time-limited promo rate — recommend quoting a flat POC fee + per-seat surcharge to cover heavy SCIM churn. Need to know frequency of provisioning (bulk import vs ongoing).

nina: They expect an initial bulk import (~400 users) then ~100 monthly churn.

evansol: Operational blocker: they require proof of domain ownership at sign-off and want SCIM to sync the following attributes: id, userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], employeeType, manager, and groups. Confirmed?

kevin: We can map all those. Note: manager is not always provided by IdP; SCIM supports manager via "manager": {"value": "id"}. If they need manager lookup by email we can add a small mapping script on our side (adds 1-2 days).

priya: Compliance blocker to flag: if PacificCorp is using an on-prem IdP behind a firewall, for Hosted SCIM we need an outbound connection from their network to our SCIM endpoint OR we recommend Dedicated/Private. If they insist on SCIM push from our side to an internal endpoint, that's only supported in Private deployments.

nina: So recommended POC flow from product/eng/security: 1) Week 0: Exchange SAML metadata, verify domain via DNS TXT, enable SAML for pilot 2) Week 1: Bulk CSV import of users to seed pilot (no SCIM yet) 3) Week 2: Enable SCIM with scoped token, run bulk sync, enable group->role mapping 4) Week 3: Ramp and validate deprovisioning.

audrey: Pricing to propose in the quote: "POC package" — flat fee $X (covers infra + support), plus $0.XX per provisioned user over 50 during the POC. I'll draft numbers after we confirm churn and expected API calls.

nina: Customer question: does SCIM provisioning count towards Redwood hosted "token usage" billing?

kevin: Short answer: no. SCIM provisioning calls are metered separately (not billed like generation tokens). However heavy SCIM operations can trigger throttling; if they plan >1000 ops/min we should move them to Dedicated capacity.

priya: Security answer: for audit/compliance we'll provide SCIM logs, token usage logs, and SAML assertion logs for the POC period as part of standard enterprise support.

evansol: Action items: @audrey draft POC commercial with promo pricing; @kevin prepare SCIM quickstart snippet and any mapping caveats; @priya prepare domain verification guide and compliance note; @nina coordinate kickoff and collect IdP metadata + sample CSV.

idp-bot: Reminder: please upload SAML metadata to the shared POC folder: https://redwood.share/pacificcorp-poc (:calendar:)

nina: Thanks — I'll confirm kickoff and share metadata by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
